analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, discussing operational and financial performance amidst challenging industry headwinds like raw material inflation, geopolitical tensions, and initial monsoon deficits. For Q1 FY27, the company reported revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, EBITDA of ₹89 crore, and profit after tax of ₹47 crore. Management highlighted that the newly commissioned NPK capacity will see steady ramp-up in utilization, and introduced several new complex fertilizer variants to support future growth. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue and PAT growth driven by capacity utilization and an integrated value chain. Management noted that expanded capacities at Meghnagar are progressively contributing to performance, supported by favorable monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and the government's Nutrient Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates revenue to increase by around Rs. 500 crore more, reaching Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management projects 35% to 40% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: Trading revenue is expected to be approximately Rs. 1,000 crore from importing around 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Rainfall improved materially in early July, resulting in rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower industry production was primarily due to supply-side constraints rather than underlying fertilizer demand weakness.
demand_outlook.quote: This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and government backing via the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework create a favourable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that with comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure, and nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure. Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported.

demand_outlook.claim: Water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher, so no stress is expected on the agriculture sector and fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher compared to earlier periods in the country. Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: Existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, with an additional 165,000 MT added to bring total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion opportunities are currently being evaluated and have not yet been approved or disclosed through statutory channels.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA are contributing progressively.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA with existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The new capacity expansion has commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
capex_expansion.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices have risen from ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Global input prices witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, and higher logistic and freight costs from mid-February onwards.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter and sulphur prices firmed up towards March.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for trading business is 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27 due to absorbed input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: For the quarter, • Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the quarter was 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: • 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing sales volumes for the quarter stood at 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT for the quarter driven by peak Rabi season demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production reached 397,263 MT, supported by high demand across markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore due to newly commissioned plants.
risks_headwinds.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore. These costs have increased because of the newly commissioned plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry's reliance on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates created a direct impact on the cost structure when global input costs increased.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects that the green ammonia capacity will start in two years, specifically in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated confidence in building on the performance momentum through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders
